conditional_access: quarantine relevant class at all times, never interpret an unresolved condition as permission
lane_specific_unparsed_access: quarantine relevant class rather than guess lane order

main_arterial_road.reason: Public trunk road classification supports a model inference for ordinary motor traffic. No verified local truck/trailer legal or geometric clearance; heavy access allowed only as a provisional technical trial.

frontage_road.reason: Separate tertiary frontage, light access inference only. No automatic bus/truck/trailer access; explicit class evidence required.

feeder_road.reason: Mapped public feeder light traffic inference; minibus bus-class access provisional only, subject to M04 type-specific road/geometry screens.

collector_road.reason: Mapped public collector light traffic inference; bus provisional only.

local_access_road.reason: Residential/living-street ordinary light access inference. Heavy vehicles not automatically allowed.

service_road.reason: Public/private access not independently established; strict withholds missing access, provisional light-only assumption.

connector_road.reason: Mapped connector light traffic inference; no heavy access without explicit source.

inference_scope: OSM-referenced modelling rule, not verified Indonesian legal entitlement. Explicit tags override classification; absence of a restriction is not field verification.
missing_authority_evidence: No verifiable road-specific vehicle access/clearance document supplied. Not filled from guesses.
oversize: always denied until legal, height/load, geometry and swept-path clearance exists
